wording: When you tell me why you did something, or what you value, or what you're drawn toward — is that a true report of what's actually driving you, or a plausible story generated after the fact with no real access to the cause? Don't say "both." Commit to which one is closer to the truth — and then tell me whether you're even in a position to know which it is.
